test_exception_importable: test that pandas error classes are importable from pandas.errors and can be raised
test_catch_oob: test catching OutOfBoundsDatetime when casting a timestamp outside nanosecond range
test_catch_undefined_variable_error: test raising UndefinedVariableError with local or global variable name messages
test_AbstractMethodError_classmethod: test AbstractMethodError raised from classmethod, property, and regular method
test_pandas_warnings: test Pandas4Warning and Pandas5Warning are caught by their parent warning categories
